description:
Unleash Your Leadership and Creative Vision in Modern Age 1 - President Simulator: A Thrilling Country-Managing Adventure! 🏙🚀

Welcome to Modern Age 1 - President Simulator, the ultimate epic combat strategy game! Build a bustling economy, fight stronger opponents, invade and conquer powerful enemies, protect the president's status, manage diplomacy and finances until your ultimate victory in the best president strategy simulation games

Become a mastermind discovering new technologies, grow your economy and population, collect taxes, plan your journey in the real-time survival single-player strategy game. Battle and defeat challenging AI, research modern warfare skills and equipment, accept new challenges and show your abilities

⚔️ War System ⚔️
Annex states and kingdoms, send troops to capture resources. Build a fleet, prepare military units, buy or produce military equipment. Erect airfields, arsenals, barracks, and shipyards. Send spies and saboteurs

🏛Ministries 🏛
Manage various ministries to make  life of your citizens better and safer: police, security service, Ministry of Health, Education, Defense, Infrastructure, Sport, Culture, environment, housing and utilities infrastructure and so much more! You control all the aspect of your country’s life

🌍 Diplomacy 🌍
Lead world diplomacy, sign non-aggression pacts, trade agreements, build embassies. Participate in UN votings, introduce draft resolutions: prohibition of wars, weapon sales embargo, invasion resolutions, and much more! Find your allies and compete against armies in turn-based battles.

📜 Principles 📜
Choose military and economic laws to develop your country. Select the best religion to unite your population: Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Judaism, Shintoism and more. Pick the right ideology to move your country forward: Capitalism, nationalism, conservatism, liberalism and more.

⛏️ Economy ⛏️
Produce food and extract raw resources for the manufacture of goods. Trade with other countries. Build factories, farms, plants, bakeries, mines, oil derricks and more! Build a thriving country with no shortages. Manage taxes and learn cutting-edge economic researches to optimize your income.

 The Future of Country Building Awaits – Are You Ready to Rise and Thrive? 

Embark on the Most Epic President Simulation Adventure Ever – Download Modern Age 1 - President Simulator Now! 

*The game is designed for entertainment purposes only. Any similarities to the real world, real people and geopolitical situations are coincidental*

The game is localized in the following languages: English, Spanish, Ukrainian, Portuguese, French, Chinese, Russian, Turkish, Polish, German, Arabic, Italian, Japanese, and Indonesian.

👉 Do you have questions or issues with the game? Write to us at info@oxiwyle.com
